test_title: PYST 15: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 13 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and fourth term is related to the third term.

SECURITY : 19ECURIT25 :: ENHANCED : 5NHANCE4 :: USAGE : ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9b750f6c904cab86cf5cfdc4bfd5c933fca17392b1cf29a1d418dffc6cc08ac.png] 

**1) **SECURITY : 19ECURIT25

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7b144fe453f2f568717d890fb99f05f38d38f6fac35eb4041375725dcf2b24b.png] 

And,

**2) **ENHANCED : 5NHANCE4

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ecdbd7209b361c27c38160323f67fe1d2c5366985539d5af36ca46a62c3f808.png] 

Similarly,

**3) **USAGE : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9af764b89c587e71a20a8d86894aa33a6c742145ea82584b406ed326c26ba395.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "21SAG5".
